title: Normalized section-ring and realization comparisons
statement: Let Lambda be a commutative condensed ring and T a w-contractible affine scheme, with continuous braided finite-exact component inverse image as in [def-zl-condensed-lisse-evaluation-model]. Given a monoidal point factorization beta and a coefficient isomorphism alpha equal to beta at Lambda, there is an isomorphism a from the profinite-terminal section ring to the affine-terminal section ring. It carries each profinite point scalar to the explicit affineScalarSection. Under a, profinite section-ring realization followed by componentDerived equals affine section-ring realization after derived scalar extension, naturally on the unbounded derived category. The profinite point-scalar realization followed by componentDerived is also naturally isomorphic to the affine point-scalar realization.

proof.text: Construct the ring map on tensor-unit global sections. Full faithfulness of component inverse image and the terminal-section equivalences prove it bijective. Make it into a CommRingCat isomorphism; scalar normalization follows by naturality and the monoidal point-factorization unit equation.
Apply the derived realization square for this fixed map. Its homomorphism is definitionally the homomorphism of the constructed ring isomorphism.
Use the proved module-composition and derived-functor associator comparison for point realizations.

proof_origin.reason: Explicit constructed section map and proved point comparison; two narrower geometric/derived obligations.

theorem component_section_realization
    (α : (componentInverse T).mapMon.obj
      (Mon.mk (profiniteCoefficient Λ.X (affineComponentSpace T))) ≅
      Mon.mk (condensedRingObj Λ.X T))
    (β : (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}).overPullback Ab.{u + 1}
      (affineComponentSpace T) ⋙ componentInverse T ≅ upperStarFromPoint T)
    (hβ : NatTrans.IsMonoidal β.hom) (hα : α.hom.hom = β.hom.app Λ.X) :
    ∃ a : Evaluation.A ((coherentTopology Profinite.{u}).over (affineComponentSpace T))
        (profiniteCoefficient Λ.X (affineComponentSpace T))
        (Over.mk (𝟙 (affineComponentSpace T))) ≅
        Evaluation.A (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (condensedRingObj Λ.X T)
          (Scheme.ProEt.mk (𝟙 T)),
      (∀ r : condensedScalarRing Λ.X,
        a.hom.hom (profiniteScalarMap Λ.X (affineComponentSpace T) r) =
          affineScalarSection Λ.X T r) ∧
      Nonempty (Evaluation.F ((coherentTopology Profinite.{u}).over (affineComponentSpace T))
          (profiniteCoefficient Λ.X (affineComponentSpace T))
          (Over.mk (𝟙 (affineComponentSpace T))) Over.mkIdTerminal ⋙ componentDerived Λ.X T α ≅
        RingDerivedScalarExtension.moduleDerivedExtension a.hom.hom ⋙
          Evaluation.F (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) (condensedRingObj Λ.X T)
            (Scheme.ProEt.mk (𝟙 T))
            (MorphismProperty.Over.mkIdTerminal @AlgebraicGeometry.WeaklyEtale T)) ∧
      Nonempty (profiniteScalarRealization Λ.X (affineComponentSpace T) ⋙
        componentDerived Λ.X T α ≅ condensedScalarRealization Λ.X T)
